human_cone_positions.scope: Explicit human-borrowed approximation; retain source license/attribution

source_papers_and_author_assets.policy: Obtain from each canonical source under its license; not bundled here

machine_setup.requires: Licensed MATLAB with the project-required toolboxes; pinned ISET and required official data; local paths must be set

frozen_generated_assets.requirements: Exact manifests plus all referenced blocks/NPY/NPZ arrays and their SHA256; copy a separately authorized local bundle or rebuild a NEW version
frozen_generated_assets.cold_rebuild_limit: Historical stage scripts require their prior master/catalog/build manifests and may have local path constants. They are not a one-command cold rebuild of every recorded identity. Inspect their prerequisites; new assets require new configuration bindings and background qualification.

checkpoints_and_caches.compatibility: Graph, weights, parameters, schema, clocks, solver, background/input reference, implementation and numerical backend must strictly match. New GPU variants and changed hardware/runtime identities reject old checkpoints; rebuild native/Numba/GPU caches locally.

historical_video_driver.meaning: Specific historical benchmark, not a clone-only generic launcher; without this exact local bundle use the shared GUI/CLI with a rebuilt graph and newly qualified background
